It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/681405668/profile RostTyme]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} Thriller.gif|First version (11 February 2020 – 29 October 2020) }} == Trivia == *This [[Emotes|emote]] is based on a dance in the Michael Jackson song [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sOnqjkJTMaA Thriller], hence the name. **The music that plays while performing this emote contains a motif from the song. **The quote of this emote also refers to the song. *Before the Overhaul Update, this was one of the few emotes not to use the noob or grey skin as the icon. == Update History == *'''11 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.0]] **'''Thriller''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. {{EmoteNavBox}}
